readerCopy.summary: The person asking for fair terms faces the person who controls the money, access, or future opportunity.
readerCopy.body: The person asking for fair terms faces the person who controls the money, access, or future opportunity. One side points to contribution, relationship, and the value created; the other points to ownership and the consequences of refusing the offer. Venus gives the desire for mutual exchange a voice, while Pluto reveals the leverage determining whether the request can matter. The opposition places fairness directly across from concentrated power. The deal may close, but everyone sees whether consent meant anything once one side could afford to walk away and the other could not.
